about: Verification rows of the DFlash v1 drafter (confidence of the argmax over its top-16, softmax with tau 1.5) for gpt-oss-20b MXFP4 (attention and head at 8 bits): lab-dev rowscal (2026-10-30) with Platt per depth 0, 1, 2, >= 3 on 13 real agent turns (pi with this model, 1,620-4,484 prompt tokens) x 256 greedy tokens (995 rounds, 3238 samples); cost with prompts-gptoss/512,4K,16K,32K: ms per round (drafter included) with k = 2..8 rows trimmed on the GPU, with isotonic regression. Only the 20b has a drafter for this family (the 120b has 24 target layers and does not fit it).
